title: SymbolSpec
description: Symbol spec snapshot (CENT-004; table symbol_specs). Stored as canonical JSON; its SHA-256 is the spec hash (T10). Values come from live symbol_info() through the conversion boundary (RISK-020); nothing here is a broker fact until M2. MT5 enumeration and flag fields are kept as the raw integers the MetaTrader5 package returns; the spec does not name their values.

schema_version.description: Schema version (DATA-010). Breaking changes need a migration and an ADR line.

params.description: Present with value FIXTURE when fixture values of unapproved parameters are in effect (RISK-005, RISK-066 item 3, MI-045). Absent otherwise; the spec names no value for the approved case.

fixture_demo_mode.description: Fixture demo only: the entry authorization mode the user set for this run in fixture_demo_mode (RISK-066 item 4). Absent outside fixture demo.

mono_seq.description: Engine monotonic sequence number for ordering within a process (DATA-003). Optional because records not written by the engine (research, Guardian ingest) have none.

symbol.description: Discovered symbol name (CENT-003), e.g. a cent gold symbol; never assumed.

spec_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the CENT-004 fields (T10).

verified_by_user.description: The user confirmed this spec (CENT-003, CENT-020 typed phrase).

trade_tick_value.description: SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE per 1.00 lot, with its currency. A missing currency means SPEC_INCOMPLETE (CGV-04).

anyOf.description: SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE_LOSS per 1.00 lot. Null if unavailable; RISK-014 then falls back to trade_tick_value.

volume_limit.description: SYMBOL_VOLUME_LIMIT (lots; 0 is MT5's 'no limit' value, not interpreted here).

filling_mode.description: SYMBOL_FILLING_MODE flags, raw integer (EXE-020 chooses type_filling from it).

swap_long.description: SYMBOL_SWAP_LONG. Its unit depends on swap_mode, so no currency is attached (CENT-007).

currency_base.description: SYMBOL_CURRENCY_BASE (for gold this is a metal code, not an account currency).

margin_initial.description: SYMBOL_MARGIN_INITIAL as reported; margin is always taken from order_calc_margin at decision time (EXP-007).
